build_note: Collector first for early lethality + execute. LDR is the default armor pen (mandatory vs Malphite/Amumu/Rammus). IE requires 60% crit - with Collector (25%) + LDR (0%) = only 25% before IE. Fix: add Galeforce or RFC as 3rd item for crit before IE. Bullet Time into grouped ARAM = free penta potential every fight.
vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards mandatory - Collector (25%) + Galeforce (20%) = 45% before IE; LDR has 0% crit
vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies - never run both
vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Galeforce if 3+ divers - delays IE but shields during ult
kit_notes: Double Up (Q) bounces off enemies hit by E-marked targets for double damage. Love Tap passive: alternate between targets for bonus damage. Strut (W) - fully charge before every fight by staying out of combat 5s. Bullet Time channels through frontline - position at 30-45 degree angle to hit 3+ enemies.
aram_specific: Pre-channel position: find 30-45 degree angle so Bullet Time hits 3+ grouped enemies. Never ult into a single target. Strut is free movement speed if you don't get hit in lane brush - stay behind minions to farm Strut stacks freely.
